description: Complete upright full-length man, cream embroidered linen shirt beneath blue wool belted kaftan with fine pale geometric trim, restrained brown fur along collar/cuffs, decorated brown leather belt and worked buckle/end, dark trousers and tall brown boots. Both hands/feet visible. Bare stone doorway with snow at ground, no headgear/armor/weapons. Full golden beard and divided crown strip/shaved sides.
